_comment: Central-government listings captured 2026-10-20, to pair with the state sources already in the feed. Only https notice links can become cards, so the IBPS registration-portal rows (http://ibpsreg.ibps.in/...) are listed here with their real target to record why they are skipped. Deliberately NOT proposed from the same page: the ISO certification, trademark/fraud-website and PwBD-SOP notices - official, but not a job a candidate can act on. Non-recruitment rows like those still reach the tracker from discovery, and the approve-notice label is what keeps them out of the feed.
